使用Tarjan进行SCC缩点，然后遍历所有边，建立DAG并将属于同一SCC的边.zh: 使用Tarjan进行SCC缩点，然后遍历所有边，建立DAG并将属于同一SCC的边归类。然后对每个SCC中的边作数学处理，得到SCC内部的最大愉悦值。再在拓扑序上dp，注意起点给定，因此除了起点之外的点的dp值设为-1，dp的更新基于前一点已被更新，即大于零。
使用Tarjan进行SCC缩点，然后遍历所有边，建立DAG并将属于同一SCC的边.en: Use Tarjan to perform SCC condensation, then traverse all edges, build a DAG, and classify edges that belong to the same SCC. Then perform mathematical processing on the edges within each SCC to obtain the maximum pleasure value inside the SCC. Then perform dp on the topological order, noting that the starting point is given, so except for the starting point, the dp values of other points are set to -1; dp is updated based on the previous point having been updated, i.e., greater than zero.

贪心。每次找能够支配当前未支配点的最大值，然后更新未支配点。.en: Greedy. Each time, find the maximum that can dominate the current undominated points, then update the undominated points.
